note: 3 days, 7 reels (max 3/day). Post at IST: Slot1=7-8AM, Slot2=12-1PM, Slot3=6-8PM. Strongest designs first.

timing_rationale.7-8AM: Morning scroll peak. Users check Instagram immediately after waking. Algorithm favors early posts — 7AM gives 1hr runway before 8-9AM commute rush.
timing_rationale.12-1PM: Lunch break window. Office workers, students open Instagram during lunch. Shorter attention — hooks must grab in under 2 seconds.
timing_rationale.6-8PM: Highest traffic window in India. Post-work relaxation, users are deeply scrolling. Best for high-retention content (tutorials, carousels, breakdowns).
